description: Re-checks an issuer's whole publication from scratch: every record's ed25519 signature against the issuer's registered key, the sequence numbers, the previous-hash links (so nothing was removed or reordered), that each notice fits the open notice format, and that every amendment or retraction points at a real earlier item. Handles key rotations: each record is checked against the key in force at its seq, and a rotation must carry both the old and the new key's signature; records an issuer declared compromised are reported as untrusted. Also reports whether the issuer's domain was verified. Read-only. Same checks as https://iomarkets.tech/issuer/<id>, which runs them in the browser.

issuer.description: The issuer id, such as acme-bank.

name: verify_issuer_publication
title: Check an issuer's signed publication
